The reports appearing in the attached articles
in the "North China Daily News" and "Journal de
Shanghai" of July 11, 1939, emanated from the same
source, the person supplying the information being
one Heinrich HANS, an Aryan German political
refugee who holds Aliens Identification Certificate
No. N.L. 1704 issued at the Hague on March 23, 1939.
HANS has been questioned by this office and,
in brief, he states the following :-
"During the morning of Tuesday, July 4, 1939
he was proceeding along North Szechuen Road near
Dixwell Road, when he observed a column of some
250 foreign soldiers garbed in the green-khaki
uniform of Japanese Marines, marching in the
direction of the Japanese Naval Barracks in
Kiangwan Road.
"Two soldiers to the rear of the column
were forced to lag behind to attend to a mobile
machine-gun they were pulling as they were
experiencing certain difficulties with it.
"During the time they were attending to it -
not more than 30 seconds - HANS avers he asked them
where they were from. They stated they were
German volunteers, having just arrived on a
Japanese freighter from Spain where they had
fought in the Spanish Civil War with the Condor

本处已对汉斯进行讯问，简而言之，其陈述如下：
“1939年7月4日（星期二）上午，他正沿北四川路靠近狄思威路（Dixwell Road）地段行进时，观察到一列约250名外籍士兵，身着日本海军陆战队的绿卡其色制服，正朝江湾路的日本海军兵营方向行进。
“队伍末尾的两名士兵因拖曳的一挺机动机枪出现故障，被迫落后处理。
“在他们处理故障期间——不超过30秒——汉斯称他曾询问他们来自何处。他们表示自己是德国志愿者，刚乘一艘日本货轮从西班牙抵达，此前曾在西班牙内战中随秃鹰

（底部手写批注）

除上述情况外，汉斯未再与这些人交谈。但他十分确信他们是德国士兵。
对于这一必须持通常保留态度看待的陈述，独立调查并未予以证实。
派驻狄思威路警署和虹口警署的警务人员近期在其辖区内未观察到任何外籍部队，而在相关区域频繁往来的可靠外籍人士也未注意到这些士兵。此外，德国官方及半官方圈子否认知晓任何关于这些人抵达的消息。
虽然本处确实在不久前收到消息称，德国和意大利军队可能会前往中国协助日本军事力量，但合乎逻辑的推断是，如果这些德国军队乘坐任何类型的货轮经由苏伊士运河航行，这样的旅程必然会成为全球媒体报道的话题，然而目前尚未见到此类报道。

July 12, 1939.
Morning Translation.

JOURNAL DE SHANGHAI dated July 11:

"RUMOUR IS CURRENT THAT A NUMBER OF GERMAN ANTI-
AIRCRAFT EXPERTS HAVE ARRIVED ON A JAPANESE
FREIGHTER"

"Japanese Authorities Deny Report"

A rumour is current in Shanghai that a number
of anti-aircraft experts arrived recently in Shanghai on
a Japanese freighter.
Interrogated regarding the matter, the Japanese
authorities denied the report which they attributed to
official Soviet propaganda.
It is said, however, (and names of witnesses
are given) that a batch of 250 German soldiers under the
command of a German officer and accompanied by a Japanese
officer, were seen at about 10.30 a.m. last Tuesday on
North Szechuen Road. The men wore Khaki uniforms cut
like those worn by Japanese marines and carried rifles
and bayonets. They were pulling along some German
materials for field telephones.
Two of these men were questioned by an Austrian-
Aryan refugee and declared that they had just arrived from
Germany on board a Japanese freighter which had been
converted into a transport. These men also said that
they had seen service in Spain before coming out to China
and that they belonged to the "S.S.," the Fuehrer's
famous black guard. They were experts of air defence.
Other members of the same group were noticed
on Thursday. The group is being accommodated in the
barracks of the Naval Landing Party near Hongkew Park.
The eye-witnesses, who are very positive,
declare that the men were not White Russian Volunteers
recruited by the Japanese authorities; they are positive
that these men are Germans.

1939年7月12日。
晨间译稿。

7月11日《上海日报》：

“谣传数名德国防空专家乘日本货轮抵达”

“日本当局否认该报道”

上海流传一种说法，称数名防空专家近期乘日本货轮抵达上海。
就此事项接受问询时，日本当局否认了这一报道，并将其归咎于苏联官方的宣传。
然而，据称（并提供了证人姓名），上周二上午10点30分左右，有人在北四川路看见一批250名德国士兵，由一名德国军官指挥，并有一名日本军官陪同。这些人穿着剪裁类似日本海军陆战队制服的卡其色军装，携带步枪和刺刀。他们拖拽着一些用于野战电话的德国器材。
其中两人受到一名奥地利雅利安难民的盘问，并声称他们刚乘坐一艘改装为运输船的日本货轮从德国抵达。这些人还表示，在来中国之前，他们曾在西班牙服役，并且属于“党卫队”（S.S.），即元首著名的黑色卫队。他们是防空专家。
周四还注意到了同一群体的其他成员。该群体正驻扎在虹口公园附近的海军陆战队兵营内。
目击者态度非常肯定，宣称这些人并非日本当局招募的白俄志愿者；他们确信这些人是德国人。

Chinese-American Daily News, Eastern Times:

ITALIAN AND GERMAN VOLUNTEERS TO FIGHT FOR JAPAN

According to information from Hongkew, the Japanese military authorities, owing to their inadequate strength in Central and South China, have consented to allow the German and Italian volunteers, who had participated in the Spanish Civil War, to come to China to take part in the hostilities. The first batch of 200 Italian volunteers arrived in Shanghai and landed at Yangtsepoo at the beginning of this month. It is said that these volunteers belong to various regiments and lack discipline. They will not have a long stay in Shanghai and will soon leave for the South China front to see active service there.

It is learned that German volunteers will also come to China to assist Japan.

《中美日报》，《时报》：

意德志愿者将为日本作战

据虹口方面消息，由于在华中和华南兵力不足，日本军方已同意允许曾参加西班牙内战的德国和意大利志愿者来华参战。首批200名意大利志愿者已于本月初抵达上海，并在杨树浦登陆。据悉，这些志愿者隶属不同团部，缺乏纪律。他们在上海停留时间不会太长，不久将前往华南前线投入实战。

获悉德国志愿者也将前来中国协助日本。

SHANGHAI TIMES.
JUL 12 1939

GERMAN BLUEJACKET REPORT DENIED
Spokesman States That Naval Circles Had Laugh At Report

A local report that 250 Germans in
Japanese Naval Landing Party uniforms were seen
marching in Hongkew provided "a good laugh" among
Japanese naval circles, a naval spokesman said
yesterday.

Referring to a report that the Germans
were "archie" experts, the spokesman declared
that the Japanese Navy did not require the services of
any "archie" experts, being "confident that it can handle
its 'archies' as well as any nation"

The spokesman said the Landing Party
headquarters was packed at present and could not
accommodate 250 Germans.

1939年7月12日

否认德军水兵报道
发言人称海军界对此报道一笑置之

针对有关这些德国人是“高射炮”（archie）专家的报道，该发言人宣称，日本海军不需要任何“高射炮”专家的服务，因为“自信在处理‘高射炮’方面不逊于任何国家”。

该发言人表示，目前陆战队总部已人满为患，无法容纳250名德国人。

Manila, a former Colonel in the
Russian Army and Lieut. Kemp.
Plans for the formation of the
"White Foreign Legion" to fight
for Japan have already been dis-
cussed with the Japanese Embassy
at San Sebastian, Lieut. Kemp
told the United Press.
James Walton, 45-year-old
New York sergeant of the
Navaree forces, Lieutenant
Lorenzo Mata, 30-year-old of-
ficer of the Spanish Foreign
Legion, Prince Alexis Achavarri,
colonel in the Imperial Rus-
sian Army, and Lieut. Kemp
are forming the "White Foreign
Legion" of Spanish civil war
veterans to battle for Japan.
Lieut. Kemp, who has been
wounded four times and decorated
twice for bravery in Spain, out-
lined the plans of the group of
adventurers.
"Plans have been completed al-
ready," he said, "and discussed
with the Japanese Embassy at San
Sebastian. I am confident we can
raise six regiments of 5,000 men
immediately and all of them ex-
perienced fighters.
"It is my idea that besides being
a crack spearhead for the Japan-
ese, we also will symbolize white
soldiers helping a yellow people to
combat the Red perils.
"This Foreign Legion aims to
help wipe out Communism in the
Far East."

《大美晚报》
1939年5月28日

白人外籍军团
希望“援助日本”

骑士之子宣布组建
六个团军队的计划

（合众社）
马德里，5月27日电。西班牙外籍军团军官、已故孟买首席大法官诺曼·肯普爵士（Sir Norman Kemp）的23岁儿子彼得·肯普（Peter Kemp）中尉今日概述了组建六个团、共计5000名经验丰富的战士以及成立一支“白人外籍军团”以在远东为日本对抗“共产主义红色危险”的计划。
这些团将由西班牙战争的老兵组成，并由一名美国人、一名来自马尼拉的军官、一名前俄国陆军上校以及肯普中尉指挥。
肯普中尉告诉合众社，为日本作战的“白人外籍军团”的组建计划已与驻圣塞巴斯蒂安（San Sebastian）的日本大使馆进行过讨论。
45岁的纽约籍纳瓦雷部队（Navaree forces）军士詹姆斯·沃尔顿（James Walton）、30岁的西班牙外籍军团军官洛伦佐·马塔（Lorenzo Mata）中尉、前沙皇俄国陆军上校阿列克谢·阿查瓦里王子（Prince Alexis Achavarri）以及肯普中尉正在组建这支由西班牙内战老兵组成的“白人外籍军团”，以为日本而战。
肯普中尉曾在西班牙四次负伤，并因英勇表现两次获勋，他概述了这群冒险家的计划。
“计划已经完成，”他说，“并与驻圣塞巴斯蒂安的日本大使馆进行了讨论。我有信心我们可以立即招募到六个团、共5000人的队伍，且所有人都是经验丰富的战士。
“我的想法是，除了成为日本的精锐先锋外，我们还将象征白人士兵帮助黄种人对抗红色危险。
“这支外籍军团旨在帮助消灭远东的共产主义。”

（右上角手写批注：No. S. B. / Date / 8039A / 41 / 3）
